The '''Calamari Cafe''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It served a wide variety of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamarian]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].
